claims.text: For this what-if only, Bob deliberately chooses when and how he uses movie-demonstrated Sentry/Void effects, including selective targeting. Safe selective control is not presented as an established film feat.
Doom faces Bob in a ruined street; Bob drives him back to create an opening for allies. This is an invented concept sequence, not a Doomsday scene or leak.
Bob might try his controlled Void effect against Doom. No success or immunity is established.
An invented second threat forces Bob to choose between pursuing Doom and protecting civilians; this does not make Bob lose mastery.
The reviewed evidence does not establish Doom's vulnerability to the Void, an automatic winner, or either character's full capabilities in Doomsday.
No comic/composite Sentry powers, unlimited power claim, automatic victory, or hypothetical image presented as film footage.
